alerts.title: New GST Update
alerts.description: Significant changes to Input Tax Credit (ITC) norms for tech service providers effective from the next fiscal quarter. Potential impact on operational margins exceeds 2.4%.

alerts.title: New MSME Scheme
alerts.description: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises announces digital transformation grants for registered entities in the manufacturing sector.

alerts.title: Data Privacy Amendment
alerts.description: Proposed amendments to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act focus on cross-border data transfer compliance. Requires immediate legal audit for international operations.
